review_scope: Selected civil expert-report provisions (Articles 162 and 170–171), criminal expert-examination provisions (Articles 144–146), and trust-service provisions (Articles 3 and 7) from official Matsne publications. English code translations and the final Georgian trust-services text were consulted; this is not an audit of all amendments or procedural exceptions.

appointment.summary_en: The court may order a necessary specialist examination by reasoned ruling; parties may also arrange an examination subject to submission rules.

items_en: Written account of the examination, conclusions and reasoned answers.

rights_duties.summary_en: The court may require explanation; parties can review the report and ask questions.

appointment.summary_en: Expert examination is initiated by a party when specialist study is required, subject to statutory safeguards.

items_en: Expert identity, qualifications and record of the false-opinion liability warning.
Examination grounds, attending persons, materials and objects examined.
Methods, reasoned answers and relevant circumstances established on the expert's initiative.

esignature.law_local: ელექტრონული დოკუმენტისა და ელექტრონული სანდო მომსახურების შესახებ, მუხლი 3
esignature.law_en: Law on Electronic Documents and Electronic Trust Services, Article 3

timestamp.basis: Law on Electronic Documents and Electronic Trust Services, Article 7
timestamp.qualified_recognition: Qualified timestamps provide presumptions of date/time accuracy and integrity of associated data. Provider and service requirements still apply.

open_questions: Matsne's default English trust-services page served the initial 2017 edition, so the final Georgian-language page is cited for Articles 3 and 7. Confirm the language and consolidation date of each code translation before filing.
Criminal Article 144 includes safeguards for examination objects and opposing-party access; their application to a specific collection or destructive test is outside this subset.
No statutory first-person declaration or current penalty formula was verified. Record the actual expert warning and appointment; do not infer them from the archive.
Foreign trust-service recognition and regional court-language arrangements have not been reviewed.
Report requirements are summarised in English. Native expert/law terms do not imply a complete reviewed translation of the report or interface.
court_language_notes: Georgian is the language represented by this profile. Civil Procedure Article 9(4) provides for proceedings in the state language and interpretation; regional language rules and the actual forum must be checked separately.
